title: fix(cli)!: the CLI opens a sign-in page only for an http(s) address and never through a shell, and os mcp connect registers only an address that passes one parse
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skill's `os mcp connect` row and its eval state no exit condition, no Windows lookup and no address character set, so nothing they teach changes; `skills/**` is outside this order's file surface

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:命令行登录只为 http 或 https、且字符规范的登录地址自动打开浏览器;连接 Claude Code 时,只登记并打印通过同一套地址校验的服务地址;在 Windows 上若找到的是 npm 安装的批处理包装,命令以退出码 1 停下并打印那一行。
- 为什么做:命令行工具启动外部程序一律不经过系统外壳、只交出校验过的地址,属于安全加固,由安全席位派发,维护者已裁定采用"停下并打印"方案。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是浏览器没有自动打开、某个地址被拒绝登记,或 Windows 上没有自动登记,用户照屏幕提示手动完成即可;整单可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The rules:

- **The CLI opens a sign-in page only for an http(s) address written in plain URL characters, and never through a shell.** `os login` and `os cloud login` hand the parsed address to the platform's opener as one argv element with `shell: false` (`open` on macOS, `xdg-open` elsewhere, `rundll32.exe url.dll,FileProtocolHandler` by its absolute path on Windows). An address outside the rule is printed, not opened, with a line saying so. "Browser opened automatically" is printed only when the opener was started; an opener that could not be started prints its own line.
- **`os mcp connect` registers and prints only an address that passes one parse, on both paths.** Whether it comes from `--url` or from the control plane, the address parses as an http(s) URL, is rebuilt from the parsed origin, holds no control character, and holds only letters, digits, `-._~:/` and an IPv6 host's brackets, so the printed Connect line needs no quoting. An address from the control plane must also be a bare host (an optional scheme and port). Anything else exits 1, with nothing registered and no Connect line printed.
- **`os mcp connect` starts `claude` from an argv array with `shell: false` on every platform.** On Windows it runs the `.exe`/`.com` that the first matching `PATH` entry rooted at a drive letter holds, by its absolute path; the current directory, relative entries and entries rooted without a drive are not searched. A batch-file shim there is not run (ruled option A): exit 1, the printed `claude mcp add` line, and both remedies.
- **Every program the CLI starts carries no shell beyond four measured allowances**, each pinned by its statement and its inputs (Acceptance notes).

**BREAKING (Windows): a batch-file `claude` is no longer run.**

- FROM: on a Windows install whose `claude` is a batch-file shim (`claude.cmd`, which an npm global install writes), `os mcp connect` registered the server and exited 0.
- TO: it registers nothing and exits 1, printing the `claude mcp add` line and saying why.
- The fix: run the printed `claude mcp add …` line yourself, or install Claude Code's native Windows build and run `os mcp connect` again.

**BREAKING: `os mcp connect` registers and prints only an address that passes the rule above.**

- FROM: an address outside it was registered and printed as given.
- TO: it is refused with exit 1; nothing is registered and no Connect line is printed.
- The fix: for `--url`, pass a base URL in those characters; for an environment, check its address in the ObjectOS Cloud console.

ADR-0087 disposition (stated in the changeset's marker): not-required, `no-migration-prescription` — no schema key, accepted value, export or stored row moves; there is nothing for a migration to rewrite and no tombstone.

Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch, carrying the `!` summary, both declaration lines, the marker and both BREAKING blocks. The CLI reference (`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `os login`, `os cloud login`, `os mcp connect`) states the same rules.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/sign-in-page-opens-http-only-without-a-shell.test.ts` — both device flows × darwin / linux / win32 × a plain and a punctuated https address: the opener's argv and `shell: false`, `exec`/`execSync` never called. Five non-http(s) addresses and three http(s) addresses outside the character set: nothing launched, the address printed. An opener that fails to start prints its own line. The Windows lookup: drive-rooted entries only (a probe answering "file" for everything still finds nothing in `.`, relative and drive-less entries, and finds a drive-rooted one), and the per-entry extension order.
- `packages/cli/test/mcp-connect.test.ts` — command level on win32: a resolved `claude.exe` runs by its absolute path, not the bare name; a batch-file shim and a missing `claude` each exit 1 with the Connect line, the reason, and the runner not called. Sixteen control-plane addresses outside the rule are refused on both the registering and the `--print` path, nothing registered and no line printed, and the refusal does not echo them; three plain host spellings register as their parsed origin. `mcpUrlFromBase` and `mcpUrlFromOrigin` take the same rule.
- `packages/cli/test/cli-launches-without-a-shell.pin.test.ts` — a TypeScript-AST source pin over every `.ts` under `packages/cli/src`, four rules: `exec-non-literal`, `exec-as-value`, `shell-option` (object literal or assignment), `shell-program`. Findings must equal the allowances by file, rule, enclosing function and statement; each allowance's inputs and the wrapper's callers are pinned. Detector battery: 34 loud cases (9 / 11 / 7 / 7 per rule, each rule held to that floor) and 18 quiet cases. The tree is read and walked once, in a `beforeAll` with a 60 s ceiling, and only files that load `child_process` are parsed: every finding needs such a load, so the other files hold none. Measured: 39 of 622 files parsed; the case run took 507 ms against 3.40 s with the prefilter disabled, which found the same set.

## Acceptance notes

- **Allow-listed in the source pin, measured, not changed here.** The rule now names three text classes an allowed command line may carry: text the CLI wrote; text held to a fixed character set or a closed set of values; the invoking user's own argument to the same command. `commands/doctor.ts` `probeTool` (CLI-written constant probes; every caller passes a literal, pinned); `commands/dev.ts` `pnpm [--filter PACKAGE --fail-if-no-match] dev` (S4: the invoking user's own argument, chosen over a character set because pnpm owns the filter grammar); `commands/init.ts` `PM install` (closed set); `utils/skills-catalog.ts` `npm pack` on Windows (exact-version charset and a quoted CLI-created directory).
- Not measured on a Windows host: the opener's argv and the client lookup are pinned with a mocked file probe and a mocked runner. A `PATH` entry that is a link rather than a regular file is not measured.
- The `--url` narrowing also refuses a base URL whose path prefix holds a percent-encoded or punctuation character; such a server has no spelling under the rule.

## Verification

<details><summary>Reverse verification (fix committed first; each mutation through an anchor that must hit, the pin's file run, the restore proven blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

17 mutation runs, 16 distinct ablations, each red and then restored:

- The opener's character set removed: 6 red (3 addresses × 2 flows). The "could not start" answer removed: 2 red.
- The control-plane address parse removed: 17 red. The `--url` character set removed: 1 red. The `--url` control-character refusal removed: 1 red.
- The drive-rooted `PATH` filter loosened: 1 red. The command running the bare name instead of the resolved path: 1 red. The batch-file refusal removed: 1 red. The second remedy dropped from the refusal: 1 red.
- Source-pin detector: each of `exec-as-value`, `shell-program`, the `shell` assignment rule and inline-load members disabled: 1 red each.
- Source-pin tree: an allowance input edited, a wrapper caller passing a built string, and an exec binding used as a value in `src`: 1, 1 and 2 red.
- The first attempt at the last one was refused by the mutation tool before any test ran (its replacement held its anchor); it was re-run with a disjoint anchor.
- After all of them: 0 changed paths, empty `git diff HEAD`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (final head cec0b8c3e unless a line names another)</summary>

- Dependency closure: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` → `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The three files above plus `test/cloud-login-keeps-active-environment.test.ts` on 5992d0dff → `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 81 passed (81)`; the one file the last commit changed, on cec0b8c3e → `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) → `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- CLI `unit` tier (`vitest run --project unit`) on 5992d0dff → `Test Files 441 passed (441) · Tests 6295 passed (6295)`. The `integration` tier is declared to CI.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the seven touched TypeScript files → exit 0; control-byte scan over every touched file → no match.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`), 100 families on cec0b8c3e, each exit captured before any pipe: 98 × exit 0, 2 × exit 3 (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, both read built packages outside the CLI and dogfood closures; NOT MEASURED locally, CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on this head). `--ran` reconciliation: `100 derived, 98 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Dogfood battery (the title carries `!`): `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock → `VERDICT command-exit 0` · `Test Files 487 passed | 3 skipped (490)` · `Tests 4125 passed | 68 skipped (4193)`, no failure. The test step ran on the cec0b8c3e tree.
- Not measured: a Windows host.

</details>

Read first: `packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/connect.ts` (`mcpUrlFromOrigin`, `mcpUrlFromBase`, `resolveClientExecutable`), `packages/cli/src/utils/open-browser.ts` (`browsableUrl`), `packages/cli/test/cli-launches-without-a-shell.pin.test.ts` (the allowances).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/sign-in-page-opens-http-only-without-a-shell.test.ts test/cli-launches-without-a-shell.pin.test.ts test/mcp-connect.test.ts test/cloud-login-keeps-active-environment.test.ts` → `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 81 passed (81)`.
